title: SeaHub DNA Typewriter Gap Analysis
detailed_heading: Detailed Dataset Analysis: DNA Typewriter lineage recording (Mouse, SeaHub)
intro: This section provides a field-level breakdown for the dataset SeaHub nominated as representative of the work the registry will need to support. DNA Typewriter is a genomic recording system: a prime editor and an engineered target array are delivered to a mouse zygote by pronuclear injection, and each cell division writes an ordered insertion into a six-position register, so that a single destructive readout at E13.5 recovers the cell's division history rather than only its present state.

Two structural features drive most of the gaps. First, cardinality breaks in both directions at once — one embryo produces a bulk amplicon library, a single-cell transcriptome library, a single-cell recorder library and a ddPCR assay, while one combinatorial-indexing run carries nuclei from two embryos across twenty-five plates. Second, the biological subject is a transgenic embryo produced by injection into a donor zygote and gestated by an unrelated surrogate, a configuration that the required fields on MouseSubject cannot express at all.

intro.label: Placeholder note.
intro.body: This analysis was prepared from a preprint and a scoping conversation, not from a metadata export. Source field names below are descriptive labels for quantities the paper reports, not real keys from a SeaHub system. Classifications are verified statements about what aind-data-schema v2.9.0 does and does not contain; they are not statements about what SeaHub records, and the metrics are not comparable to the Patch-seq, Cell DIVE mIF, TEA-seq or AICS analyses, all of which were prepared from real field inventories.

sources_reviewed: Yu Q, Kim H, Seidel S, et al. In vivo reconstruction of the cell lineage history of a developing mouse with DNA Typewriter, from zygote to late organogenesis. bioRxiv 2026.07.29.741625 (posted 2026-07-30) — Methods, Computational Methods, Data/Code availability
SeaHub scoping meeting, 2026-09 — assays, source systems, registration-scope questions
aind-data-schema v2.9.0, commit 18114d7b — core/, components/, docs/source/aind_data_schema_models/
CELLxGENE Discover schema v7.1.0, commit 1cb494af — transcriptomic cross-reference only
sample_asset: Embryo #3 (Mus musculus, C57BL/6J, E13.5, sex not determined), 1 of 10 transferred, 1 of 3 carrying detectable recorder integrations
Recorder: piggyBac-delivered PEmax-P2A-dTomato and epegRNA-circTAPE; 11 TAPE integration barcodes; ~7 PEmax copies by ddPCR
Four acquisitions from one embryo: bulk TAPE amplicon-seq (NextSeq 2000), sci-RNA-seq3, single-cell TAPE, duplex ddPCR (QX600 AutoDG)
Pooling: nuclei from embryos #2 (~24M) and #3 (~10M) co-processed across 6 RT plates -> 6 ligation plates -> 25 PCR plates at ~400,000 nuclei per plate
Derived: 1,340,794-cell dated phylogeny, 640,012-cell backbone, imputed node annotations, NextCell browser
Source: GEO GSE341627; code at github.com/seidels/dtt-mouse-analysis; intermediates on the NextCell site

gap_summary.gap: Cardinality breaks in both directions within one study
gap_summary.detail: One embryo yields four assay-level assets and one sci-RNA-seq3 run carries nuclei from two embryos. Acquisition.subject_id is a single required str; specimen_id may be a list but check_subject_specimen_id requires the subject ID in each entry, so it cannot carry a second animal. Pool ID, pool size, member subjects and demultiplexing method are all unrepresentable. Sixth appearance of this gap and the first dataset exhibiting both directions together.

gap_summary.gap: No Study or Cohort entity for the injection cohort
gap_summary.detail: Ten embryos were transferred from one injection session, three carried integrations, one was pursued, and two indexing experiments produced the libraries. None of these groupings has a home above data_description.tags[], which is free text and unsearchable. This is also the container SeaHub asked for. Same gap as Patch-seq, mIF, Immunology cohortGuid and AICS collection_name.

gap_summary.gap: Modality closed enum missing amplicon-seq, bulk RNA-seq and digital PCR
gap_summary.detail: Three of the four acquisitions have no modality term. The 22-value Modality enum contains SCRNASEQ but nothing for targeted amplicon sequencing, bulk transcriptomic sequencing or quantitative PCR. BARSEQ and MAPSEQ denote anatomical projection mapping, not a genomic recorder readout. Blocks modalities, data_streams, instrument.modalities and QCMetric.modality simultaneously, as it did for scATACseq and ADT in TEA-seq.

gap_summary.gap: Engineered recorder construct, barcode library and integration inventory have no schema home
gap_summary.detail: subject_details.genotype is a free-text string designed for inherited alleles; the recorder is delivered somatically at E0.5, mosaic, and present at variable copy number, so a single string cannot carry it. NonViralMaterial offers name, source, lot and concentration only — no construct map, cassette, backbone or designed identifier space — and nothing holds the per-animal measured state. Needs a subject-level genetic-modification record, not an extension container.

gap_summary.gap: date_of_birth is required and meaningless for an embryo; no developmental stage field
gap_summary.detail: MouseSubject.date_of_birth is required and BEFORE-validated. An embryo harvested at E13.5 has a conception date and a harvest date but no birth date, so any value entered is a fabrication. Developmental stage — the primary temporal anchor of the experiment — has no field. CELLxGENE binds stage to MmusDv, where E13.5 is an exact term. Make date_of_birth conditional and add an ontology-bound stage field.

gap_summary.gap: Sex enum admits only Female and Male; the embryos were not sexed
gap_summary.detail: Sex is a required enum with exactly two values and no sentinel for not-determined or not-applicable. E13.5 embryos processed whole for nuclei were never sexed, so the record cannot be completed honestly and the field cannot be left null.

gap_summary.gap: BreedingInfo cannot express a zygote donor plus an unrelated gestational surrogate
gap_summary.detail: BreedingInfo requires maternal_id, maternal_genotype, paternal_id and paternal_genotype and models two genetic parents. This dataset has three contributing animals: a superovulated C57BL/6J donor female, a sperm donor, and a pseudopregnant CD-1 surrogate who contributes no genetic material. The concepts share a name but not a domain. The donor and surrogate undergo procedures while producing no data asset, leaving it undecided whether they are registered subjects at all.

gap_summary.gap: All molecular preparation steps fall to SpecimenProcedureType.OTHER
gap_summary.detail: Harvest and flash freezing, nuclei isolation, two-step fixation (methanol then BS3), genomic DNA extraction, reverse transcription, Tn5 tagmentation and two-step indexed library preparation — every step between the animal and the sequencer. FIXATION exists but nuclei isolation does not, so one source procedure splits across one mapped concept and one catch-all. Fifth independent appearance, after Patch-seq, mIF, TEA-seq, Immunology and AICS.

gap_summary.gap: Three-level combinatorial index hierarchy has no representation
gap_summary.detail: Cell identity in sci-RNA-seq3 is the composition of a reverse-transcription index, a ligation index and a PCR index across 6, 6 and 25 plates. The first index is the only record of which embryo a nucleus came from, so without a plate and well model the demultiplexing provenance lives solely in analysis code. Loading density (~400,000 nuclei/plate) drives collision and doublet rate and has no field. AICS raised the same absence for plate and well; this dataset nests it three deep.

gap_summary.gap: Library design and per-embryo parsing references are required to read the raw data and cannot be registered
gap_summary.detail: The amplicon FASTQ is uninterpretable without two per-embryo reference sets: a whitelist of 12-base integration barcodes and an insertion vocabulary of admitted edit symbols. These are simultaneously derived outputs and required inputs, which the linear source_data[] model cannot express. A file required to parse the raw data is part of the registered asset, not an annotation about it.

gap_summary.gap: ProcessName vocabulary omits every pipeline step, and the lineage tree has no asset shape
gap_summary.detail: ProcessName has no entry for demultiplexing, read alignment (STAR against mm39, GENCODE vM37), duplicate removal, count-matrix generation or phylogenetic inference, so the entire pipeline registers as OTHER or ANALYSIS. Reference genome and annotation build have no dedicated fields. Whether the 1,340,794-cell dated tree registers as one derived asset, a family, or a database-resident object is undecided — the same question raised for Patch-seq reconstruction annotations.

gap_summary.gap: metadata.location is a single string; raw data sits at GEO and intermediates on a project website
gap_summary.detail: Raw data is deposited at GEO under GSE341627, intermediates are hosted on the NextCell site, and neither is an Allen-managed path. D11 states a file path is sufficient and D7 covers unowned data, but the single-string field cannot hold a repository accession, a project-site URL and a bucket simultaneously. Same shape as the Patch-seq multi-directory and TEA-seq CellRanger gaps, with the authoritative copy held externally.

gap_summary.gap: other_identifiers and institution fields cannot express five institutions and two external accessions
gap_summary.detail: The dataset carries a GEO accession, a bioRxiv DOI, a GitHub repository, and two IACUC protocols (#2530, #2401), with contributions from SeaHub, the Allen Institute, UW, HHMI and Fred Hutch. other_identifiers has no structure for typing identifiers by registry, and data_description.institution expects one registry-resolvable organization. The procedure-level ethics_review_id is a scalar str, forcing a choice where two protocols apply.

gap_summary.gap: No checksum field anywhere in the metadata core
gap_summary.detail: A grep for checksum, md5 and sha256 across src/ at commit 18114d7b returns nothing. File integrity cannot be verified from the registry alone, which matters more here because the authoritative copy is held externally at GEO and could change without the registry knowing. Belongs in the platform layer alongside the storage reference.

gap_summary.gap: coordinate_system is required where a sequencing run has no spatial frame
gap_summary.detail: Instrument.global_coordinate_system is required and every transform is checked against it. None of the four acquisitions has a spatial frame, so all four would be obliged to declare a fiction. Patch-seq recorded an Illumina sequencer forced to declare IMAGE_XYZ; this dataset would do the same four times over. Exempt non-spatial modalities, or add an explicit not-applicable coordinate system.

field_intro: These tables document field-level mappings for the core schemas (subject, genetic modification, procedures, acquisition, processing). Source field names are descriptive labels, not keys from a SeaHub system — see the placeholder note above.

fields.notes: Direct once a durable identifier replaces the manuscript's ordinal label. Require a persistent ID at onboarding.
C57BL/6J (JAX 000664). Required Strain entry; standard.
Mus musculus. Required Species value.
Primary temporal anchor; determines how much history the recorder could write. Add ontology-bound stage field (MmusDv pattern).
Required, BEFORE-validated. Embryo has conception and harvest dates, no birth date. Make conditional; require an alternative temporal anchor.
Required enum, Female/Male only, no sentinel. Add not-determined and not-applicable values.
Genetic mother and a subject in her own right. Decide whether contributing animals are registered subjects.
Different strain, no genetic contribution; BreedingInfo has no slot for a non-genetic contributing animal. Add surrogate reference with strain and role.
Free-text string for inherited alleles; cannot carry a somatically delivered, mosaic, variable-copy construct. Add a genetic-modification record.
Optional[List[str]] accepts both. Procedure-level field is scalar str — flag it.
Injection.targeted_structure is a MouseAnatomyModel; a zygote pronucleus is not an anatomical structure in that vocabulary. Clarify target vocabulary for subcellular/embryonic injection.
NonViralMaterial carries name, source, lot, concentration only. No construct map, cassette, promoter, insulator or backbone. Genetic-modification record.
Defines the identifier space every lineage call depends on; free text would make it unsearchable and unvalidatable. Register as a referenced design artifact.
Per-animal, measured not designed, and the partition key for all recorder analysis. Genetic-modification record.
Explains the order-of-magnitude difference in recorder activity between embryos. Genetic-modification record with measurement method.
SeaHub raised transgene present versus activated as a distinction the registry must carry. Genetic-modification record.
Fits the type, but is performed on the donor female rather than the registered subject. Resolve which animal the procedure attaches to.
Surgery is performed on the surrogate; the subject is the transferred embryo. Model the surrogate role in BreedingInfo.
No entry for harvest or cryopreservation; STORAGE describes conditions, not the freezing step. Vocabulary addition.
FIXATION exists, nuclei isolation does not; one source procedure splits across two target concepts. Vocabulary addition.
Produces the input to every amplicon library; recordable only as OTHER. Vocabulary addition.
The most consequential ex-vivo step for a sequencing dataset has no type. Same absence Patch-seq recorded for SMARTer v4 and Nextera. Vocabulary addition.
ProtocolMixin expects a protocols.io DOI; a textbook chapter is legitimate provenance the field cannot express. Clarify accepted protocol identifier types.

entities.name: Acquisition — bulk amplicon sequencing of TAPE

fields.notes: No amplicon or targeted-DNA-sequencing entry. BARSEQ/MAPSEQ denote projection mapping. Modality addition or ontology binding.
No dedicated device class for a sequencer. Clarify which device class applies.
Determines whether the amplicon is recoverable from read 1 or reverse-complemented from read 2. Acquisition configuration, not a processing parameter. Add read-structure field.
Bounds library complexity and therefore the interpretability of barcode counts. Add library-preparation input fields.
Drives duplicate rate; expressible only through an extension container, which is not a semantic match. Add library-preparation fields.
Required and recursively validated; a sequencing run has no spatial frame. Exempt non-spatial modalities.

entities.name: Acquisition — sci-RNA-seq3 with paired single-cell TAPE readout

fields.notes: Applies. CELLxGENE identifies it precisely as EFO:0030028, which a closed enum cannot express. Consider ontology binding.
Single required string; specimen_id list cannot carry a second animal because of the substring validator. Decompose at onboarding or add subjects[].
The first index is the only record of which embryo a nucleus came from. Container hierarchy model.
Cell identity is the composition of three indices across three plate levels. Container hierarchy model.
Determines collision and doublet rate, handled in the paper by a dedicated doublet-removal stage. Container hierarchy model.
Changes the expected expression profile; CELLxGENE requires it as a controlled field for this reason. Add controlled cell/nucleus field.
Two libraries from one cDNA pool sequenced in one run; neither one acquisition nor two independent acquisitions describes this. Resolve with the cardinality decision.
One logical pool may be sequenced across two instrument models. Clarify instrument cardinality.
No PCR or quantification modality; registering as OTHER makes the measurement undiscoverable. Modality addition or ontology binding.
Fluorophore and probe classes exist for imaging and in-situ work; a qPCR probe pair with a reference assay reuses the names but not the domain. Clarify probe modelling for quantification assays.
Per-subject quantitative result with a stated formula; gates whether a dataset is worth registering. Genetic-modification record.
No entry; the step assigning reads to plates and therefore to embryos records as OTHER. ProcessName additions.
No alignment entry; reference genome and annotation build have no dedicated fields. ProcessName additions plus reference fields.
The principal derived artifact of every transcriptomic dataset has no process name. ProcessName additions.
Derived from the data and then required to parse it; both an output and an input, which linear source_data[] cannot express. Register as referenced reference-set assets.
Spans all cells of one embryo with node-level ages and imputed annotations. One asset, a family, or a database-resident object is undecided. Define registration shape for graph products.
Populated here, which is unusual against the corpus baseline where code URLs are absent. Use as-is.
Single string; raw data at a public repository, intermediates at a project site, neither Allen-managed. Asset root plus manifest; resolve external-ingest policy.
No checksum field exists in the metadata core. Platform-layer integrity record.

fields.source_type: list[str] (SeaHub, Allen, UW, HHMI, Fred Hutch)
fields.notes: Fields expect one registry-resolvable institution; this dataset has five and a publication led outside the Allen Institute. Structured multi-institution provenance.
